info.title: Update Target Collaboration
info.description: This API is used by Seller to update STANDARD target collaboration.

put.description: This API is used by Seller to update STANDARD target collaboration.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

name.description: The name of the target collaboration.

end_time.description: The end time of the target collaboration.

commission_rate.description:
The desired commission rate for the target collaboration. The value is measured in ten thousandths. For example, 3587 means the commission fee equals 35.87% of the original price. The range is [100, 8000].
Increasing product commissions will take effect immediately, while reducing product commissions will take effect at 00:00 the next day if the current product has been added to the showcase by a creator, otherwise it will take effect immediately.

target_ad_commission_rate.description:
The commission rate applies only to orders generated from ads. If a creator’s video is used as an ad without this rate being set, the resulting orders will instead earn either:
- The Shop Ads commission you configured in open collaboration, or
- The standard commission defined in this invitation.
The commission rate is specified in increments of 1/10,000.
For example, 1000 stands for 0.1 or 10%.

products.description:
The information about the products provided by the seller for target collaboration with creators in the target collaboration.
The maximum number of products is 100.
When a product is deleted from the product list, if the deleted product has been added to the showcase by the creator, it will take effect at 0:00 the next day, otherwise it will take effect immediately.

creator_user_open_ids.description: The list of Creators' TikTok User Open IDs invited in the target collaboration. The maximum number of creators is 50. [More details](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/3obfokj6)

phone_number.description: The phone number of the seller.

whatsapp.description: The phone number used by the seller to register for WhatsApp.

telegram.description: The  seller's Telegram username or phone number.

line.description: The phone number used by the seller to register for the Line app

seller_contact_info.description: Contact information for the seller in the target collaboration.

has_free_sample.description: If true, free samples are provided to creators invited to the target collaboration.

is_sample_approval_exempt.description:
If true, creators invited to the target collaboration are exempt from seller review and will automatically be approved for a free sample.
Note that if has_free_sample=false, this field will not take effect.

free_sample_rule.description: The free sample rules set by the seller in the target collaboration.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

target_collaboration_conflicts.description: A list of creators and products with target collaboration conflicts that caused target collaboration update failure.

remove_creator_open_ids.description: The list of creators' TikTok User Open IDs that have not been successfully removed. More details:https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/3obfokj6

remove_product_ids.description: The list of product ids that have not been successfully removed.

add_creator_open_ids.description: The list of creators' TikTok User Open IDs that have not been successfully added. More details:https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/3obfokj6

commission_rate.description: The desired commission rate for the target collaboration. The desired commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, 3587 is a commission rate of 35.87%. This value must be a minimum of 1000.

add_products.description: The list of products that have not been successfully added.

change_commissions.description: The list of commission information that has not been successfully changed.

end_time.description: The end time of the target collaboration, which has not been successfully updated.
